$comment: Scoped upstream sync policy for the Y Harness fork. Read scripts/upstream-sync/README.md.
`baseline` is the upstream commit whose content this fork has already ingested for
`include`. Advance it only through a merged sync PR: sync.mjs rewrites it in the branch
it prepares, so merging that branch is what moves the marker.
`prerequisites` cover what a synced package needs but does not own: upstream moves
dependency entries between manifests (the root, shared utilities) without touching the
packages this fork follows, and a missing entry only shows up as a failing typecheck.
Manifests merge dependency sections only; other changed fields are reported, never applied.
`sources` is for prerequisite source trees; it lists nothing today because
packages/client/ui-slots is the slot runtime every UI package shares, and taking it
needs its own review rather than a path entry.
